instruction: From the Schematic Editor, plot the current schematic to a PDF named "test_schematic.pdf" in the project folder.

verification.condition: Check that /home/user/Desktop/test_files/kicad_pro/test/test_schematic.pdf exists and begins with the magic header "%PDF-".
verification.expected_result: A valid PDF file "test_schematic.pdf" is created in the project directory.
